One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and herbs. Air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes, shake, then 200°C for 5–8 minutes. Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. 9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Then flatten. I just use my fist lol. 2️⃣ Then season both sides with seasoning mix recipe above. Air fry on 400 degrees F for 9-10 minutes. 3️⃣ While that’s cooking, make your caesar dressing by adding all your ingredients into a bowl and mixing. 4️⃣ Now chop up your chicken breast once done and add to a bowl. Combine with the buffalo caesar dressing 1/6th caesar dressing. 5️⃣ Chop up 300g romaine and add 1/6th caesar dressing to it. Can add more but we don’t want the romaine to be soggy. 6️⃣ Now put together your chalupas. Lay one pita down then add to on side 6g mozzarella, 2g parmesan, 1/4th of your chicken caesar dip, 2g parmesan, 6g mozzarella. 7️⃣ Fold your chalupa tightly. Spray both sides with cooking spray and add to air fryer on 400 degrees F for 4 minutes. I added some ramekins on top of each one to make sure they stayed closed while in the air fryer. 8️⃣ Once done, open them up, add your caesar salad and enjoy! #caesarsalad #chalupa #airfryer #highproteinmeals#mealprep

Sheet Pan Garlic Parmesan Chicken and Potatoes 🧄🧈 For ALL of you asking about the app, search “Osta” on the app or Google play store 🫶 Minimal effort, maximum flavor… juicy chicken, crispy potatoes covered in garlicky parmesan butter perfection 🔥 For the potatoes: - 1.5 lbs (680 g) baby potatoes - 1/3 cup butter, melted - 1 cup parmesan cheese - 8 garlic cloves, minced - Seasonings: 2 tsp each of paprika, oregano, garlic powder, salt, black pepper - 3 tbsp olive oil For the chicken: - 6 to 8 chicken thighs, boneless & skinless - Seasonings: 1 tbsp seasoning salt, 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp italian seasoning, 1 tsp cumin - 1 lemon, juiced - 2 tbsp mayonnaise For the garlic & onion: - 2 garlic heads + 2 tbsp olive oil + 2 tsp salt - 1 red onion, cut into chunks + olive oil, drizzled For the Aioli:  - 1/3 cup greek yogurt + 1/3 cup mayonnaise - 2 roasted garlic heads - 1/4 lemon, juiced - 2 tsp black pepper + 1 tsp salt - 3 tbsp chives, chopped For the Baste (optional ): - 1/4 cup mayonnaise  - 1/4 cup parmesan  - 2 tsp paprika Instructions: 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken, seasonings, lemon juice, garlic, and mayonnaise. Mix well and marinate for as long as you wish (up to overnight). 2. Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Add the potatoes to a large casserole dish. Toss with the melted butter, parmesan, olive oil, garlic, and seasonings. Spread evenly. 3. Top with the chicken thighs. Add the red onion chunks around the dish & drizzle them with olive oil.  4. Slice the tops off the garlic heads, drizzle with olive oil and salt, wrap in foil, & place in dish. 5. Bake for 40 mins. Broil for the last 2–3 mins if desired.  6. Optional but recommended: Mix together mayo, parmesan, and paprika. At the 20-min mark, baste the chicken & return to the oven. 7. In a bowl, combine the yogurt, mayo, lemon juice, salt, pepper, and chives. Squeeze in as much of the roasted garlic as you wish OR chop them up first. Mix. 8. Finish with fresh parm, chives, & lemon slices. Enjoy! #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv #dinner #recipesoftiktok #dinnerideas

TERYAKI CHICKEN & STICKY RICE 🍚🍗 I could eat this every week on repeat!! Recipe below ⬇️ Ingredients (makes 4 servings): - 4 chicken breasts - 1/2 cup soy sauce  - 2 tbsp honey or brown sugar  - 1tbsp sesame oil  - 2 garlic cloves, crushed  - 1/2 tsp ground ginger  - 1 tbsp cornflour mixed with 1tbsp water  Serve with:  - black sesame seeds  - 2 cups sticky rice  - 400g broccoli  1. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces 2. Add to a bowl with the soy, honey, sesame oil, garlic and ginger - you can cook straight away but I find it better to marinate in the fridge for at least 30 mins (or longer if you have)  3. Add chicken to a pan on medium-high heat till chicken is cooked (you may have sauce left in the bowl, this can remain here then be added once chicken is almost cooked) 4. Add remainder of sauce with your cornflour mixture and cook for a few mins till sauce has glazed the chicken  5. Serve with sticky rice, broccoli and sesame seeds  This keeps for 3 days in the fridge, or can be frozen after cooling! ❄️ #mealprep #mealprepideas #lunchideas #highproteinmeals #worklunchidea

✨Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wrap 🌯 Ingredients Chicken * 500g chicken thigh or breast Marinade * 1 tsp cayenne powder * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * Salt to taste * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp black pepper *1/2 tsp red chilli flakes * 1 tbsp ginger & garlic paste *1tbsp oil Garlic Parmesan Sauce * 1 tbsp butter * 2–3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 small white onion, finely chopped * 270ml double cream * ½ cup whole milk * 1 tsp cayenne powder * Salt to taste * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tsp onion powder * 1 tsp oregano * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan Parmesan Fries * Fries * Parmesan cheese * Cayenne powder * Garlic powder * Salt to taste For the Wrap * Tortilla wraps * Mozzarella cheese * Parmesan cheese * Oil, for frying Method Chicken * Marinate the chicken with all the marinade ingredients for at least 30 minutes. * Heat 2 tbsp butter and 2 tbsp oil in a pan. * Cook the chicken over medium heat for 4–5 minutes per side, or until fully cooked. Slice into strips. Garlic Parmesan Sauce * Melt the butter with a little oil. Sauté the garlic until lightly golden. * Add the onion and cook until softened and lightly golden. * Add the cream and milk, then stir in all the seasonings. * Cook for 2–3 minutes over medium heat. * Add the Parmesan and mix until smooth and creamy. Parmesan Fries * Toss the fries with Parmesan, cayenne, garlic powder and a little salt. Assemble * Spread about 2 tbsp of garlic Parmesan sauce over a tortilla. * Add Parmesan fries and sliced chicken. * Top with mozzarella and Parmesan. * Fold tightly into a wrap. Crisp the Wrap * Heat 1–2 tbsp oil in a pan over medium-low heat. * Cook the wrap for about 2 minutes on each side, until golden and crispy. * Serve with Parmesan sauce and fries. LOOK IDENTITY — AETHER NOMAD 9099 🛸🤎🤍🩶 📍 Date officielle de naissance du look : 22.08.9099 Un look imaginé pour une époque où la mode ne cherche plus à suivre le futur… elle vient directement de lui. Le pantalon cargo à double ceinture signé @flyerrer.official conserve l’ADN street des années 90/2000, mais ici, il est propulsé dans une autre dimension. Taille volontairement abaissée, volumes XXL, poches cargo, nuances beige poussière et chocolat : la silhouette semble avoir été retrouvée dans une archive venue de 9099. Cette fois, le haut change complètement l’histoire. La maille zippée à col montant et ses détails effet fourrure construisent une silhouette plus sculpturale, plus mystérieuse, presque extraterrestre. Sa palette claire dialogue parfaitement avec le pantalon et crée un contraste entre douceur, puissance et futurisme. Les deux ceintures deviennent une véritable signature visuelle. Les sneakers massives ancrent le look dans le présent, tandis que les lunettes futuristes et le chapeau que j’ai imaginé transportent l’ensemble bien au-delà de notre époque. 🕶️🛸 Et le plus important ? Je n’ai pas simplement assemblé des vêtements. J’ai construit une identité. La façon de porter chaque pièce, les proportions, les accessoires, les matières et l’attitude ont été pensés pour créer une silhouette que l’on remarque avant même de comprendre pourquoi. Aujourd’hui, les gens tournent la tête. Ils demandent des photos. Ils cherchent à comprendre. En 9099, ils chercheront probablement à comprendre d’où cette archive est arrivée. ⚡️ Conseil de style : Ne cherche pas à porter ce que tout le monde porte. Cherche à créer quelque chose que les autres n’ont encore jamais vu. La mode devient puissante lorsqu’elle ne demande pas : « Est-ce que ça plaît ? » Elle demande : « Est-ce que ça va rester dans leur mémoire ? » Un vrai look ne suit pas l’époque. Il lui donne quelque chose à rattraper. 🛸🤎🤍🩶🕶️ @flyerrer.official 🖤 @_startexceedend_ 🤍 #aethernomad9099

✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

For all of you asking - the Osta app link is in my bio, or you can search “Osta Recipes” on the App Store or Google Play 🫶 🤎Brownie Batter Lava Cake - 330 g (2 ¾ cups) cake flour, sifted - 70 g (¾ cup) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - 2 ½ tsp baking powder - ½ tsp baking soda - 1 tsp fine sea salt - 360 g (1 ½ cups) organic cane sugar - 360 g (1 ½ cups) non-dairy milk, room temp - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar - 120 g (½ cup) plain non-dairy yogurt, room temp - 240 g (1 cup) neutral oil (grapeseed, canola, sunflower) - 2 tsp vanilla bean paste Instructions 1. Preheat oven to 350°F (or 345°F high altitude). Grease and line three 8-inch pans with parchment. 2. In a medium bowl, whisk flour, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. 3. In a measuring cup, combine milk and vinegar; let curdle 5 minutes. Whisk in yogurt, oil, and vanilla. 4. In a large bowl, whisk sugar into wet mixture until dissolved. 5. Sift dry mix into wet; fold gently until smooth. 6. Divide evenly into pans and bake 22-25 minutes, until tops spring back. Cool 10–15 minutes, remove from pans, wrap, and chill. 🤎Brownie Lava  - 100 g (½ cup, packed) light brown sugar - 50 g (¼ cup) organic cane sugar - 70 g (5 tbsp) non-dairy butter - 40 g (½ cup) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - 40 g (5 tbsp) heat-treated all-purpose flour - 80 g (⅓ cup) non-dairy cream - 1 tsp vanilla bean powder - ½ tsp fine sea salt - 70 g (½ cup) chopped non-dairy chocolate (~50% cocoa) - 60–90 g (¼–⅓ cup) non-dairy milk, to thin if a looser lava is desired Instructions 1. Melt butter with both sugars over medium heat until glossy. Keep gritty; don’t dissolve all sugar. 2. Whisk in cocoa + flour until paste-like. 3. Stream in cream gradually until molten but thick. 4. Stir in vanilla and salt. 5. Let cool 5–7 minutes until warm but pourable. Fold in chopped chocolate — it should soften but not fully melt. Let cool to room temp before assembling. 6. Whisk in 60–90 g non-dairy milk at the very end, until desired consistency is reached. Use immediately.  🤎Raw Brownie Batter Squares (Layer + Garnish) - 100 g (½ cup, packed) brown sugar - 50 g (¼ cup) sugar - 90 g (6 tbsp) non-dairy butter, room temp - 60 g (½ cup) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - 120 g (1 cup) AP flour - 2–3 tbsp non-dairy cream - 1 tsp vanilla bean paste - ½ tsp fine sea salt - 70 g (½ cup) chopped non-dairy chocolate (~50% cocoa) Instructions 1. Cream butter with sugars until fluffy. 2. Mix in cocoa, flour, and salt until sandy. 3. Add vanilla + cream; mix to a stiff dough. 4. Fold in chopped chocolate. 5. Press into a parchment-lined pan, chill 30 minutes, then cut into small squares. 🤎Chocolate Buttercream - 339 g (1 ½ cups) non-dairy butter, room temp - 510 g (4 ½ cups) powdered sugar, sifted - 68 g (½ cup + 1 tbsp) Majestic Dutch-process cocoa powder - Pinch tsp fine sea salt - 2 tsp vanilla bean paste - 45-68 g (3–4½ cup) non-dairy cream *(start with 3 tbsp; add to desired texture)* Instructions 1. Beat butter until creamy. 2. Add powdered sugar, cocoa, salt, and vanilla. Beat on low, then whip on high until fluffy. 3. Stream in cream until smooth and silky. 🤎Assembly 1. Place first cake layer on board. Pipe a buttercream dam. 2. Spoon in brownie batter lava (thicker or thinner depending on preference) and scatter a few brownie batter squares. 3. Repeat with second layer, then add final cake. 4. Frost outside with chocolate buttercream. 5. Garnish with more brownie batter squares and drizzle extra lava over the top. 6. Slice → rich chocolate layers spill with molten brownie batter, studded with chewy brownie bites. 🤎To Serve For the ultimate gooey effect, microwave a chilled slice for 8–10 seconds before serving. The heat reactivates the lava, giving you that molten flow on demand. #chocolatecake #lavacake #brownie #vegancake #browniecake

Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

They always ask why I didn’t make more | full recipe ⬇️ Smoked to perfection with @harmosgrill flavored pellets Serves: 6–8  Total Time: ~2–3 hours (including marinade) Ingredients Chicken 3–4 lbs bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs (non-negotiable) 3–4 tbsp spicy brown mustard 2 tbsp Cuso’s Hot Honey Seasoning 2 tbsp Cuso’s Roasted Garlic & Onion Seasoning Grill / Smoke Harmos wood pellets: Spanish Barbecue Pirate & Turkish Barbecue Traveler Jalapeño Green Sauce 2–3 jalapeños (adjust for heat) 1 cup fresh cilantro 2–3 garlic cloves ½ cup Greek yogurt 2–3 tbsp olive oil Salt, to taste Black pepper, to taste Instructions 1. Marinate the Chicken Add chicken thighs to a large bowl. Coat fully with spicy brown mustard. Season generously with Cuso’s Hot Honey + Roasted Garlic & Onion seasoning. Mix until evenly coated. Cover and refrigerate for at least a few hours (overnight preferred). 2. Preheat the Grill Preheat your pellet grill to 350°F. Load with Harmos pellets (Spanish Barbecue Pirate + Turkish Barbecue Traveler) for deep smoky flavor with paprika, garlic, rosemary, and spice notes. 3. Make the Jalapeño Green Sauce Add jalapeños, cilantro, garlic, Greek yogurt, olive oil, salt, and pepper to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning or heat. Chill until ready to serve. 4. Smoke the Chicken Place chicken directly on the grill grates. Cook for about 1 hour, until internal temp reaches 160°F. 5. Crank the Heat Increase grill temp to 500°F. Cook until chicken hits 180°F internal and skin gets crispy with great color. 6. Serve Remove from grill and rest a few minutes. Serve with the jalapeño green sauce on the side or drizzled over top. #HarmosGrill  #HarmosWoodPellets  #HarmosFlavoredPellets

GRILLED CHICKEN + RICE + BROCCOLI 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken breast • 200 g cooked white rice • 200 g broccoli • 2 tbsp olive oil • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Season chicken with salt & pepper Grill until fully cooked and juicy Steam broccoli until tender Serve with rice and portion into containers 🍱 2. TERIYAKI CHICKEN + RICE + SESAME 🛒 Ingredients: • 400 g chicken • 3 tbsp teriyaki sauce • 200 g cooked rice • 1 tbsp sesame seeds 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Cook chicken until browned Add teriyaki sauce and let it glaze Serve over rice and top with sesame seeds 🍝 3. CREAMY CHICKEN PASTA 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g chicken • 200 g pasta • 200 ml heavy cream • 2 garlic cloves • 50 g parmesan cheese • Salt & pepper 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Cook pasta and set aside Sauté chicken with garlic Add cream + parmesan → make sauce Toss with pasta and portion 🥡 4. CHICKEN STIR-FRY + VEGETABLES + RICE 🛒 Ingredients: • 300 g chicken • 200 g cooked rice • 200 g mixed vegetables • 3 tbsp soy sauce • 1 tbsp oil • 2 garlic cloves 👨‍🍳 Instructions: Stir-fry chicken with garlic Add vegetables + soy sauce Cook until glossy and coated Serve with rice 🌿 5. Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Chicken Enchilada Rice Bake🔥508 cals 48g protein 7g fat 63g carbs Cookbook in bio 🔗 Ingredients: this makes 6 meals 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breast, cut into bitesized pieces 1½ cups jasmine rice, uncooked 1 can (10 oz) mild red enchilada sauce 1 3/4 cups chicken broth 1 medium yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 1 cup corn, drained 1 can black beans, drained and rinsed 1 small can mild diced green chiles  2 tbsp minced garlic 100g reduced-fat Mexican-blend cheese Seasoning blend: 2 tsp chili powder 1½ tsp ground cumin 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp dried oregano Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°F. 2. Grab a 9x13 baking dish - add the chicken breasts, 1½ cups uncooked jasmine rice, diced onion, bell pepper, corn, black beans, green chiles and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with chili powder, cumin, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper. Pour in the 10-ounce can of enchilada sauce, 1 3/4 cups of warm chicken broth 4. Spread it into an even layer and make sure the rice is submerged beneath the liquid. 5. Cover the dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and sprinkle 150g of reduced-fat Mexican-blend cheese evenly over the top. 7. Return it to the oven uncovered for another 10–15 minutes, or until the cheese is melted, the rice is tender and the chicken has reached 165°F. 8. Let it rest for 10 minutes so the rice can absorb the remaining liquid. 9. Divide into six servings and finish with your favorite toppings. Serve hot & enjoy! ✨ Did you know you can make DIY taste-safe kinetic sand with simple ingredients from your pantry? It's non-toxic, budget-friendly, and perfect for toddlers! My 3-year-old often stays busy for an hour playing with it—molding shapes, digging treasures, and pretending to bake "cakes."  Ingredients You’ll Need: 1 cup baking soda 1/2 cup cornstarch 1/2 cup sugar 2–4 tablespoons warm water  (mix with food coloring of your choice) 1 tablespoon cream of tartar Step-by-Step Instructions: Mix the dry ingredients In a large mixing bowl, combine the baking soda, cornstarch, sugar, and cream of tartar. Stir until evenly distributed. Prepare the colored water In a small bowl, add a few drops of food coloring to the warm water. Adjust the intensity of the color by adding more or fewer drops. Combine wet and dry ingredients Gradually add the colored water to the dry mixture, 1 tablespoon at a time. Mix with a spoon or your hands until the sand reaches your desired consistency—moist and moldable, but not sticky. You may not need all the water, so add it slowly! Test and play Once the mixture holds its shape when squeezed, it’s ready for playtime! If it feels too dry, add a few drops of water. If it’s too sticky, sprinkle in a bit more cornstarch. Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Chicken Au Poivre‼️ Full Video Things you need  Whole chicken Sherry Wine (Holland House Cooking Wine) 1 Large Shallot Minced Garlic (3-4 cloves) Heavy Whipping Cream, 2 - 2.5 cups Fresh Cracked Black Pepper Fresh Rosemary, chopped    Chicken Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder, Chili Powder, Paprika, Kinder’s Buttery Poultry Seasoning, Dried Parlsey  Sauce Seasoning: Salt, Cracked Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Garlic Powder Directions  1. Prepare the Chicken Clean the chicken using 1 part vinegar to 2 parts water. Remove the insides, then butterfly the chicken by cutting out the backbone with kitchen shears. Lay the chicken meat‑side up, pat dry, and press down firmly to flatten. Season generously with the listed seasonings, including salt and cracked black pepper on the underside. 2. Cook the Chicken Preheat the oven to 375°F. Heat a large skillet over medium‑high. Once hot, sear the whole chicken skin‑side down until browned, about 4–5 minutes per side. If cooking multiple chickens, repeat the process. Transfer the browned chicken(s) to a baking dish. Add about 1/3 cup water to the bottom of the dish, cover, and place in the oven while you prepare the sauce 3. Prepare the Sauce In the same skillet used for searing, add diced shallots, garlic, and chopped rosemary. Cook for 3–4 minutes, scraping up any browned bits from the chicken. Deglaze with 1/2 cup Sherry cooking wine and cook for 2–3 minutes. Add 2 – 2.5 cups heavy whipping cream, whisking to combine. Season with the listed sauce seasonings and cook for 3–4 minutes, whisking occasionally. 4. Finish the Dish Remove the chicken from the oven and pour the cream sauce over the top. Return to the oven and cook for 60–90 minutes, depending on the size of the chicken, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone. Baste the chicken with the cream sauce every 30 minutes, stirring the sauce before each baste. For reference: a 3–4 lb chicken typically cooks in about 1 hour and 20 minutes. 5. Serve Serve the chicken over mashed potatoes or rice, and garnish with parsley. #cookingvideos #chickenaupoivre #recipes #fyp #mashedpotatoes

videos.caption: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Nashville Hot Chicken x Garlic Bread🔥 Crispy double-dredged Nashville hot chicken, with melty mozzarella, pickles, and homemade ranch, all packed onto garlic bread 😮‍💨 this thing will disappear FAST Garlic butter: 4 tbsp butter, softened 3 cloves garlic, minced 1 tbsp chopped parsley Chicken: 3 chicken thighs 3/4 cup flour 1/4 cup cornstarch 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp cayenne 1/2 tsp salt 2 eggs, beaten 4 cups oil, for frying Nashville hot sauce: 1/2 cup hot oil, reserved from frying the chicken 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp chili powder 1/2 tsp salt Ranch: 1/2 cup mayo 1/2 cup sour cream 1 tbsp fresh lemon juice 1 tsp dried dill 1 tsp dried parsley 1/2 tsp garlic powder 1/2 tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp salt 1/4 tsp black pepper To build: 1/2 loaf French or Italian bread 1 cup shredded mozzarella Sliced sweet pickles Steps 1.  Whisk flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, cayenne, and salt in a bowl. Beat eggs separately. 2.  Whisk mayo, sour cream, lemon juice, dill, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper for the ranch. 3.  Heat oil to 350°F in a deep pot or skillet. Dredge chicken in the flour mix, then egg wash, then flour mix again for a double coating. 4.  Fry until golden and 165°F internal, about 4-5 min. Drain on a rack. Save 1/2 cup oil for the Hot Oil 5.  Whisk the reserved hot oil with cayenne, brown sugar, paprika, garlic powder, chili powder, and salt. Toss the fried chicken in the sauce. 6.  Preheat oven to 400°F. Spread garlic butter evenly on the split loaf. 7.  Top with mozzarella. Bake 5-6 min until fully melted. 8.  Remove and layer the sauced chicken on top, then add more cheese. 9.  Broil 3-4 min until the second layer melts. Remove.  10.  Top with pickles, then drizzle ranch over the top. 11.  Slice and serve Enjoy! #easyrecipesathome #garlicbread #nashvillehotchicken #cooking #viralrecipes

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal

ONE-PAN CREAMY CHICKEN & CHORIZO PASTA  10/10 – this was absolutely f*cking gorgeous  WHAT YOU’LL NEED: • 650g chicken breast, diced • Cooking spray • 2 tsp paprika • 1 tsp oregano • 1 tsp salt • 1 tsp black pepper • 150g chorizo, skin removed and diced • 1 medium brown onion, diced • 30g tomato purée • 250g dried pasta of choice • 800ml chicken stock • Extra paprika, oregano, salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tsp garlic granules • 100ml single cream • Fresh chives, to garnish HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Dice 650g of chicken tits and add them to a large bowl. 2. Spray the chicken with cooking spray, then add 2 tsp of paprika, 1 tsp of oregano, 1 tsp of salt and 1 tsp of black pepper. Mixy mixy motherf**ker! Make sure every piece is completely coated. 3. Add 150g of diced chorizo to a large pan with no oil and cook until beautifully browned and releasing all that glorious chorizo oil. 4. Add the diced brown onion and cook until softened. 5. Chuck in the seasoned chicken tits and 30g of tomato purée, then cook until the chicken is around halfway cooked. 6. Add 250g of dried pasta and pour in 800ml of chicken stock. Give everything a good stir, cover with a lid and simmer for around 10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the pasta is cooked and the chicken is completely cooked through. 7. Season again with some extra paprika, oregano, a pinch of salt, a pinch of african american pepper and 1 tsp of garlic granules. Garrrrrlic! 8. Pour in 100ml of single cream and mixy mixy motherf**ker! until everything is coated in that ridiculously creamy chorizo sauce. 9. Divide into 5 portions, finish with some freshly chopped chives and enjoy! FULL MACROS: Roughly per portion: 527 calories 45g protein 45g carbohydrates 18g fat 4g fibre DEFINITELY going in the rotation 😂 Cheers, @Panacea Palm

Preheat oven to 400°F 2. Add chicken thigh, 1 ½ cups uncooked rice, diced onion, red bell pepper, cherry tomatoes, spinach, and minced garlic directly to the baking dish. 3. Season with 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 ½ tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, ¾ tsp smoked paprika, ¾ tsp salt, ½ tsp black pepper, and red pepper flakes if using. 4. Pour in 3 cups chicken broth and stir everything together until evenly combined and the rice is submerged. 5. Cover the baking dish tightly with foil and bake at 400°F for 45 minutes. 6. Remove the foil and add fresh parm and go back in the oven uncovered for another 15 mins at 400° 7. Finish with the remaining fresh parsley  Serve hot and enjoy! Drone footage in Nepal showed roads destroyed and buildings buried by thundering water the color of wet cement. Nepalese authorities ramped up operations in the worst-affected districts of Nuwakot and Rasuwa. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet is not a one-off. The Lhende Khola river system has now flooded twice in just 14 months and the increasingly unstable Himalayan ice system threatens communities, infrastructure and water supplies across one of the world’s most densely populated regions. The region saw similar flash floods in August last year, when a glacial lake in Tibet overflowed because of high temperatures. Nine people were killed, and critical infrastructure, including a bridge connecting Nepal and China, was damaged.

How to build an AI employee that works while you sleep. An AI agent is just a loop (goal → step → check → repeat) that can reach for tools. On its own it hits a wall: it forgets everything, waits for you, owns nothing. The ladder that turns it into staff: • ① context — files YOU write; it reads them every run so nothing's generic, and they grow (you're raising it) • ② memory — facts + your rules + how-to's; a skill is a memory • ③ a lane, not a task • ④ tools — MCP, ~1 min to connect • ⑤ a schedule — wakes on its own, pings you only for decisions • ⑥ guardrails — low-stakes it does; high-stakes it drafts and waits for your yes I run mine from a Google Sheet — it drafts every reply in my voice, I approve in 10 minutes, every 30 minutes it sends the approved ones and learns from my revisions. The moat: anyone can buy the same AI. Nobody has your context. Come build it with me. #aiemployee #aiagent #aiautomation #professorglitch

👀🍫FUDGY BROWNIE CHEESECAKE BARS…  No baking required. Makes 7 BIG bars, each with: 240 cals, 10g protein, 10 net carbs Here is another viral recipe that absolutely holds up to the hype. You’ve got a rich brownie base, a creamy cheesecake center, and a chocolate layer right on top. These are a little more dense than your traditional brownie cheesecake bar, but made with better-for-you ingredients, incredibly satisfying, and SO GOOD. Big thanks to @nora.dora99 for this amazing recipe! Here’s how to make them: FOR THE BROWNIE BASE: 150g almond flour 30g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 3 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Splash of vanilla extract Mix everything together until you have a brownie batter. Press it firmly into a parchment-lined loaf pan or small baking dish and freeze for 10 mins. FOR THE CHEESECAKE LAYER: 250g fat-free cream cheese (regular works too!) 10g sweetener of choice Splash of vanilla extract Squeeze of lemon juice I processed this in a food processor, but you can also use a hand mixer. Then spread it over the brownie base and freeze for about 45 mins. FOR THE CHOCOLATE TOPPING: 40g unsweetened cocoa powder 2 tbsp calorie-free sugar-free maple syrup 1 tbsp melted coconut oil 2 tbsp unsweetened almond milk Mix until smooth, spread it over the cheesecake layer, and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to set. I cut these into 7 bars, but you can cut them into whatever size bars you like to manage your own goals. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 serving (1 meal prep): Protein: 47g Carbs: 78g Fat: 13g Calories: 616 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 14oz chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 3 tbsp cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil Honey Soy Glaze - 2 tbsp soy sauce - 3/4 tbsp oyster sauce - 2 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp minced ginger Korean Cucumber Kimchi Salad - 3 Persian cucumbers, whole, medium - 1/4 tbsp salt - 1/2 tbsp rice vinegar - 1/2 tbsp minced garlic - 1/2 tbsp sesame oil - 1 tbsp gochugaru - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1/2 tbsp brown sugar - 1 tsp sesame seeds Rice (and topping) - 1.25 cup cooked rice (white or brown) - 2 green onions, medium - 1 tsp sesame seeds How to make it yourself: 1. Cut your cucumbers into 1 inch pieces and crush them with a mallet 2. In a bowl, add your cucumbers and salt and set aside for 10 minutes. 3. Drain all excess liquid, rise your cucumbers with water, pat them dry with a paper towel, and in a new bowl add rice vinegar, minced, garlic, sesame oil, sesame seeds, soy sauce, brown sugar, and gochugaru and mix well to make your spicy cucumber kimchi 4. Season your chicken evenly with salt, pepper, and cornstarch 5. In a bowl, mix together soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, minced garlic, and minced ginger to make your glaze 6. In a pan on medium hear coated with spray oil, cook your chicken until golden brown, then flip and cook until both sides are golden brown with a crispy crust 7. Lower the heat to low and pour your glaze on top of the chicken and let it sit for 1 minute 8. EASY & DELICIOUS PROTEIN PREP 🔥 Episode 1️⃣   I’ve just discovered the best way to meal prep chicken for the week. Follow me for tomorrow's video where I’ll show you 3 easy recipes to make with it!  Take your chicken, marinate in incredible flavours and roast it in the oven and you are left with the juiciest and most delicious chicken for the week.  Calories & macros (when divided into 5) 📊 296 calories 36g P | 5g C | 14g F This is week’s 1 of this new recipe series and all you need to do is:  1. Add 900g boneless, skinless chicken thighs to a large bowl or tub. You can trim off the excess fat if you want but I left it . 2. Blitz 1 white onion in a food processor & add it to the chicken.  3. Add the 2 tbsp of lemon juice, 3 tbsp tomato paste, 2 tbsp sriracha & 2 tbsp plain or greek yogurt 4. Add 3-4 pinches salt, black pepper, 1.5 tbsp thyme, 1.5 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp chilli powder   5. Mix really well and marinate for 2-6 hrs, but even better overnight. You can also make it right away if you like. The longer you leave it, the better the flavour!  6. When you're ready to eat, preheat your oven to 190 degrees Celsius 375F. Remove chicken from the fridge and let it come up to room temp (about 30 mins) before placing in the oven. 7. Pack the marinated chicken tightly into a loaf pan (my measurements were 8.5x4.5x2.5). Place in the oven for 50 mins. 8. Remove the chicken from the oven, gently tilt the pan into a glass jar to remove the excess juices. Pour the juices over the chicken, then repeat. Set juices aside and use for soups. 9. Flip loaf pan onto a cutting board and cut chicken thin slices or strips. I portioned mine into 5 but you can also make it into 6.  Serve however you want. Follow for tomorrow's video where I’ll show you 3 easy recipes you can make with this prepped chicken!

High Protein Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice🍗🍘 57g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Serving - 6 Total) 562 Calories 56gC | 11gF | 57gP Ingredients: 1.2KG Thinly Sliced Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 2 Tsp Olive Oil 1/2 Diced Brown Onion 500g Diced Capsicum/Bell Peppers 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 960g Cooked White Rice Creamy Cajun Sauce: 30g Light Butter (Nuttelex Light) 1/2 Tsp Cajun Seasoning 400ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy) 150g Light Cream Cheese 1/2 Tsp Chilli Powder 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese Steps:  1. Start by seasoning your thinly cut/butterflied chicken breast generously on each side with cajun seasoning, olive oil & mix well until each piece is fully coated. 2. Cook the chicken on medium - high heat for approximately 4 minutes on each side, once cooked set it aside. 3. Leave the chicken juice in the pan & cook diced brown onion, diced capsicum/bell peppers & diced garlic cloves until softened. 4. Add light butter to the middle of the pan with a bit of cajun seasoning & let the seasoning toast for approximately 1 minute, then add cooked white rice & mix well until fully incorporated. 5. To a seperate pan on medium heat add light butter with a bit more cajun seasoning, after about 1 minute add light evaporated milk with a bit more cajun seasoning, smoked paprika, grated parmesan cheese & mix until smooth & creamy. 6. Equally distribute the chicken, rice & sauce into 6 servings, sprinkle with parsley flakes & enjoy.  #chickenrecipes #mealprep #easyrecipe #highprotein #healthyrecipes

WANT MOIST CHICKEN? These are the 2 simple cooking hacks for the juiciest chicken you’ve ever had. I usually do chicken thighs, but this is an amazing way to make regular chicken super moist! You need a little baking soda, to cook with the lid on & let it rest, and you’ll never have dry boring chicken again. Ingredients 2 chicken brst 1 tbsp olive oil 1/4 tsp baking soda 1 tsp oregano 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp smoked paprika Juice and zest of 1 small lemon Salt & pepper to taste Optional: 2 tbsp  yogurt Here is how I made it: 1.Add 2 chicken brsts to a bowl, drizzle with olive oil, season with salt and pepper, 1 tsp oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tbsp smoked paprika, 1/4 tsp baking soda to soften up the fibers, the zest & juice of a lemon, and optional: 2 tbsp plain yogurt. Mix well, and make sure the chicken is at room temperature (not cold!) This is important!! 2.Let this marinate for 30 minutes (outside of the fridge). By not using cold chicken, it help cook the chicken evenly. 3.Bring a pan to medium heat. Once it’s hot, place the chicken in the pan. Cover with a lid and cook for 3 mins on the first side. This is going to trap the moisture. 4.After 3 mins, flip it, cover with the lid, reduce heat to MEDIUM-LOW, and let it cook for another 7-8 mins. If you used cold chicken, or if your pan wasn’t hot enough, or if your chicken was too thick, this may require more time (and not be juicy, so follow the directions! 5. After 7-8 minutes remove the chicken from the pan, place it on a cutting board or plate, and let it rest for at least 5 minutes. This allows the juices to redistribute throughout the chicken, making it more tender and locking in the juices.   6.After resting, slice the chicken breasts against the grain and serve. You can serve this however way you wish – with your favorite veggies, salad, or with rice, quinoa, or if you’re looking for lowcarb/keto options, my @Kaizen Food Company lowcarb rice. Chicken Broccoli Cheddar Dump & Bake 🥦🧀 Easy, creamy, cheesy, and all made in one dish! Perfect for a simple weeknight dinner.  🛒INGREDIENTS: • 2 packs Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice • 2 cans reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken • Chicken broth, using the 2 empty soup cans to measure • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 bag frozen broccoli  • Shredded cheddar cheese 🧂SEASONINGS:  • Chicken seasoning (I used Chicka Licka Bam)  • Garlic powder • Onion powder • Paprika • Dried parsley 👩‍🍳HOW TO MAKE IT: 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Add both packs of Knorr Broccoli & Cheddar Rice and both cans of reduced-sodium Cream of Chicken to a 9x13 baking dish. 3. Fill each empty Cream of Chicken can with chicken broth, pour the broth into the baking dish, and mix everything well. 4. Steam the frozen broccoli according to the package directions, then dice it into smaller pieces. 5. Evenly distribute the diced broccoli over the rice mixture, gently nesting some of it into the rice. 6. Place the chicken tenderloins on top, season with the seasonings listed above, then drizzle with oil and rub the oil and seasonings evenly over the chicken. 7. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35 minutes. 8. Remove the foil and sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese over the top. 9. Return to the oven and bake uncovered for about 10 minutes.   10. Let rest for a few minutes, then serve & enjoy!! #DumpAndBake #ChickenDinner #EasyDinner #ChickenRecipes #EasyRecipes

videos.caption: VOLCÁN CHOCOLATE 👇receta escrita👇 CLICK @laura.lopez.mon para más recetas fáciles 💥GUÁRDATE💥 esta receta de pastel de chocolate | lava cake, facilísimo de hacer con 5 ingredientes, sin robots ¡nunca falla! ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍 INGREDIENTES 4 unidades 200 g chocolate (mínimo 55% de cacao) 70 g mantequilla 4 huevos M 70 g azúcar 50 g harina trigo común (sin levaduras) Para pincelar los moldes : mantequilla y cacao puro en polvo ➖➖➖➖➖➖ 📍ELABORACIÓN 🔹️ Pon en un recipiente el chocolate y la mantequilla y fúndelo. Deja atemperar 5 minutos 🔹️ Mientras pon en un bol los huevos y el azúcar y bate con unas varillas hasta que espumen. Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. Introduce en el congelador 30 minutos 🔹️ Saca del congelador e introduce en el horno precalentado a 220°C durante 12 minutos ⚠️ la temperatura interior de tu horno puede variar respecto a la mía (cada horno es un mundo) por lo que el tiempo de cocción puede variar entre 12 y 15 minutos. Deberás probar variando los minutos hasta conseguir el punto, pero nunca será menos de 12 ni más de 15 🔹️ Saca del horno y deja reposar 2 minutos. Separa la pared con el fijo de un cuchillo y desmolda 🔹️ Sirve inmediatamente ➖➖➖➖➖➖➖ Feliz día 🤗 #lauralopezmon #lavacake #micuitchocolat #volcandechocolate #coulant

I tried something a little different today — a blueprint-style colouring page. First, I filled the entire page with my huge blue marker, going horizontal, vertical, and in circles to get a really even, non-patchy background. Then I drew a grid over the whole page, coloured the lines white, and added little details like lines, measurements, and text to mimic a real blueprint. Honestly, the process wasn’t quite as fun as I had imagined 😅 but the result turned out pretty cool and graphic, so I’m still happy with it. What do you think — does it actually look like a blueprint? And would you try this technique yourself? #coloringpage #coloringtechnique #blueprinteffect #creativecoloring #artprocess
